items.description: Khan Tengri is a majestic pyramidal peak in the central Tian Shan, famous for its marble summit that glows red at sunset.
facts: Elevation: 7,010 meters
Located on the border of Kyrgyzstan, Kazakhstan, and China
Known as the 'Prince of Spirits' or 'Lord of the Sky'
World's most northerly 7,000-meter peak

items.description: The Tian Shan, or 'Celestial Mountains', is a vast mountain system that covers most of Kyrgyzstan's territory.
facts: UNESCO World Heritage site
Home to the massive Enilchek Glacier
Stretches over 2,500 kilometers across Central Asia
Highest peak is Jengish Chokusu

items.description: The Alay Valley is a wide, high-altitude basin in southern Kyrgyzstan, located between the Alay and Trans-Alay mountain ranges.
facts: Average elevation of 3,000 meters
Traditional summer pasture for Kyrgyz nomads
Traversed by the famous Pamir Highway
Offers stunning views of Lenin Peak

items.description: Ala Archa Gorge is a stunning alpine national park near Bishkek, featuring rugged peaks, fast-flowing rivers, and accessible glaciers.
facts: Located just 40 km south of the capital
Contains over 20 glaciers and 50 mountain peaks
Established as a national park in 1976
Popular destination for hiking and mountaineering

items.description: The Terskey Ala-Too range borders the southern shore of Lake Issyk-Kul, known for its dense spruce forests and dramatic alpine scenery.
facts: Highest point is Karakol Peak (5,216 m)
Name means 'shady side of the mountains'
Famous for the Jeti-Oguz red rock formations
Region rich in hot springs and waterfalls

items.description: The Kungey Ala-Too range forms the northern border of Lake Issyk-Kul and is characterized by its sunny, southward-facing slopes.
facts: Name means 'sunny side of the mountains'
Forms the natural border with Kazakhstan
Provides a dramatic backdrop to northern Issyk-Kul resorts
Popular for mountain trekking and horse riding

items.description: Chong-Kemin is a uniquely diverse valley and national park located between Bishkek and Issyk-Kul, offering varied flora and fauna.
facts: Established as a national park in 1997
Crossed by the fast-flowing Chong-Kemin River
Home to rare species like the snow leopard
Popular for white-water rafting and ecotourism

items.description: The Arpa Valley is a remote, high-altitude plateau in the Naryn Region, known for its extreme climate and isolation.
facts: Situated at an altitude of around 3,000 meters
One of the coldest inhabited places in Kyrgyzstan
Used primarily as a vast summer grazing land
Rich in wildlife including Marco Polo sheep

items.description: The Fergana Valley is a fertile and densely populated basin in Central Asia, with its eastern parts forming a vital agricultural hub for Kyrgyzstan.
facts: Shared between Kyrgyzstan, Uzbekistan, and Tajikistan
Famous for its silk production and ancient history
The warmest region in Kyrgyzstan
Watered by the Naryn and Kara Darya rivers
